findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved a $42,500 agreement with Howard Johnson & Associates, architects, to design and supervise an enclosure for the Martin Luther King Swimming Pool at Bay View Playground, Third Street and Carroll Avenue.

findings.address_as_written: M. H. de Young Memorial Museum renovation
findings.description: The Fine Arts Museums described to the Recreation and Park Commission a major renovation of the de Young Museum inside the existing building: new American art galleries, conservation laboratories for paintings, tapestries and decorative arts, more storage and a restaurant where the art school then was; Adolph Rosekrans, the museums' architect, showed schematic drawings.

findings.address_as_written: Chinese Pavilion and garden, Golden Gate Park (San Francisco - Taipei Sister Cities)
findings.description: Lim P. Lee of the San Francisco-Taipei Sister Cities Committee told the Recreation and Park Commission that Taipei's mayor, Chang Feng-shu, visiting in March, had offered the city a Chinese pavilion and garden for Golden Gate Park; the committee would raise matching money, and an American-style playground for Taipei was suggested in exchange. The Commission named a committee to work on it.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, October 9, 1975
